strings.dialogue.authoring_example.authoring.gre: Take your time. The road will still be there.

You can start with whether you're hungry. The rest can wait.
Dad bends toward the odometer. He pats the seat once, then helps me loosen the bag.
I didn't know what to say when I got here.
You're here. Leave the bag for a moment. Have you had water?
strings.dialogue.campaign.campaign_cirebon.nodes: Some of it. I learned things I still use here. Leaving wasn't a mistake.
You don't have to give the whole trip a name yet. Your tea is getting cold.
Mira clears the empty cups. I ask her which turn takes me back to the main road.
Did you find what you went for?
I'm not sure what coming back means.
I used to take the bus the other way. Cirebon to Jakarta. Every Sunday evening.
strings.dialogue.campaign.campaign_epilogue.node: That's okay. We can clean this first.
That's okay. You don't have to decide before breakfast.
I take the other cloth. From inside, Mom calls us to the table.
I still don't know what comes next.
The interview might lead somewhere. I'm not sure yet.
There's a cloth on the seat if you want it. That road dust gets into everything.
There's no need to arrive with a speech. Tell us when you've found a place to sleep.
We'll be here. Your room has clean sheets. Ride while there's light and stop when you need to.
I'll call after I stop for the night. Tell Dad the bike is doing well. See you soon, Mom.
I'm close. A little nervous, actually.
Please don't wait outside for me.
Have you stopped somewhere? I can hear the road. Your father keeps checking whether the gate opens all the way.
That sounds useful here. The role includes mentoring as well as delivery. What would you want to ask us?
We value that judgment. We have another interview round after this. What would you need to know before then?
I'd like to understand the team's pace, and what support looks like when plans change. Thank you. I'll read your follow-up after I get home.
I reduced the scope and made the risks visible.
I asked the team what we could safely defer.
Thanks for making time during your trip, Raka. Can you tell me how you handled the service migration when the deadline changed?
strings.dialogue.campaign.campaign_lumajang.node: I can't fit the whole slope into a picture. I leave the camera in my pocket.
The bottle is warm. Down below, someone is walking through a field.
When I stand up, the ridge is still partly hidden. I put the bottle away and take my time fastening the helmet.
The ridge is farther away than it looked from the road. A line of cloud rests below its edge.
Neither have I. Here, move that bag. Tell me about the bike first.
Of course. The lane still floods at the corner, so don't follow me too closely.
We spend the rest of the visit talking about people we both know. Some of the names take a moment to come back.
Can we walk before we talk?
You found the place. I was about to send another set of directions. Sit down; the kettle's already on.
The chairs are different. Someone has left a sketchbook open beside a glass of tea.
I draw the shape of the window. It doesn't need to become anything else.
At the next corner, I notice another window I'd like to draw. I leave a blank page for it.
Walk past the old meeting place.
Outside the copy shop, students are arguing about a poster. I used to spend whole afternoons choosing a typeface.
strings.dialogue.campaign.campaign_ngawi.nodes.a: For a few minutes, yes. You can put your helmet there. The bench is dry.
strings.dialogue.campaign.campaign_ngawi.nodes.b: That would be all right. Let those trucks go ahead of us.
strings.dialogue.campaign.campaign_ngawi.nodes.c: A truck passes. We watch it disappear around the bend, leaving the bench quiet again.
strings.dialogue.campaign.campaign_ngawi.nodes.s: I still stop here. My wife liked the shade. Since she died, I bring one cup and somehow look for two places to put it.
strings.dialogue.campaign.campaign_pekalongan.no: No. Those bundles are waiting too. They'll leave when the rain does.
There's hot water in the flask. You can refill your cup.
The rain softens. I finish the last of the tea before carrying my helmet back outside.
Move your helmet away from that edge. The roof leaks there when the wind turns.
strings.dialogue.campaign.campaign_salatiga.node: I put the phone face down. The cloud shadow keeps moving across the slope.
For a while there is only wind, and a bird somewhere I can't see.
I stay until the shadow reaches the road below. For once, I haven't been checking the time.
The engine ticks as it cools. Below the turnout, a small truck moves between the trees.
strings.dialogue.campaign.campaign_semarang.node: The promotion looks good from outside. I keep postponing a conversation with my wife about moving. I don't know why.
You can tell me without making it sound manageable. We can also just eat for a minute.
By the time we reach for the bill, both plates are empty. Dimas asks me to message him when I get home.
You seem to have things figured out.
I didn't know who to tell about the job.
You still pick the seat facing the door. I ordered what we used to get. Hope that's all right.
Do you have younger siblings? No? Then perhaps you were the one making the noise.
Good. I'll bring a little more rice. They're going to argue about that answer for a while.
strings.dialogue.campaign.campaign_solo.nodes.cl: I finish my food while the argument over homework carries on. Nobody asks me to explain why I'm here.
strings.dialogue.campaign.campaign_solo.nodes.st: Sorry about the noise. My daughter is doing her homework here. Her brother thinks he can help.
strings.dialogue.campaign.campaign_tegal.nodes.a: Easy to do. Hold the cloth here. We'll turn the wheel by hand.
strings.dialogue.campaign.campaign_tegal.nodes.b: Then your hands might remember before you do. Take your time.
strings.dialogue.campaign.campaign_tegal.nodes.c: The rear wheel turns freely. I wipe my hands and put the cloth back beside the tools.
strings.dialogue.campaign.campaign_tegal.nodes.s: My father showed me this once.
Your chain is dry. Nothing terrible. Put it on the stand and let the engine cool.

strings.dialogue.slice.mother.nodes.key.text: Yes. And he still thinks I don't know.

strings.dialogue.slice.warung.nodes.far.text: That's a few more cups of tea from here.
strings.dialogue.slice.warung.nodes.father.text: Dad helped me keep it that way.
strings.dialogue.slice.warung.nodes.rider.text: That a Thunder outside? My uncle had one. Yours looks better.

strings.dialogue.slice.warung.nodes.room.text: There's a guesthouse down the road. Green sign, just after the fields. They'll have a dry place for your bike.
strings.dialogue.slice.warung.nodes.start.text: Move your bag in a bit. The water comes off that corner.
strings.dialogue.slice.warung.nodes.sugar.text: You and my husband. He says that, then steals my drink.

Yes, thank you. I'll wait here a while.
strings.dialogue.slice.warung.nodes.tea.speaker: Sari

strings.dialogue.slice.warung.nodes.wait.text: Take that chair. The other one's got a short leg.
strings.phone.calls.0.note: Mom asked whether I had eaten. I told her about the team being cut. She said I could come home. Dad still leaves the gate key in the same place.
strings.phone.messages.0.text: Let me know when you stop. Dad says check the tire pressure before you leave.
strings.phone.messages.1.reply: Thanks. I'm heading home for a bit.
strings.phone.messages.1.text: Heard what happened. I'm around if you want to talk. Or just complain about the coffee.
strings.phone.messages.2.reply: Thank you. Could we arrange a time next week?
strings.phone.messages.2.text: Hi Raka, a colleague recommended you for a senior engineering role. Your experience looks relevant. Would you be open to a conversation next week?
strings.phone.messages.3.reply: They're inside. The bike is doing fine.
strings.phone.messages.3.text: Rain here too. Don't leave your gloves on the seat. They take forever to dry.
strings.phone.messages.4.reply: I'll stop by. It will be good to see you.
strings.phone.messages.4.text: If you're still coming through, I'll be at the little place near the corner tonight. We don't need an occasion.
strings.phone.messages.5.reply: Thank you. I've found a room with a desk. I'll join from here.
strings.phone.messages.5.text: Our conversation is confirmed for this evening. A quiet connection is enough; no presentation needed. We'll talk through your recent work and leave time for your questions.
strings.phone.messages.6.reply: Thank you. I'll review the details when I get home.
strings.phone.messages.6.text: Thank you for the thoughtful conversation. We'd like to arrange the next round after your trip. Please let us know a suitable day once you're settled.
strings.phone.messages.7.reply: I remember. I'll message when I've stopped.
strings.phone.messages.7.text: The gate latch still sticks. Pull it toward you before lifting it. No hurry.
strings.phone.messages.8.text: Made it? No need for a long reply. Just checking.
strings.phone.photos.0.caption: I used to watch the road from behind his shoulder. He never seemed to be in a hurry.
strings.phone.photos.0.title: Dad and me
strings.phone.photos.1.caption: Raincoat, toolkit, charger. The laptop came too. One night in Karawang first.
strings.phone.photos.1.title: Packed for the road
strings.phone.photos.2.caption: Sari made room for my bag under the roof. A cup of tea, and time to let the rain pass.
strings.phone.photos.2.title: A place out of the rain
